basic_info.description: Great starter home in quaint Bernal Heights. The main floor features a spacious living room, 2 bedrooms, bathroom, the kitchen and an additional room that could be converted into a bedroom.  There is also an additional room downstairs. The extra room on the main floor and the room downstairs provide flexibility for use as bedrooms, offices, or hobby spaces. First-time buyers or those looking for a property with potential, this is a great opportunity for those of you looking to live in a home and improve it to your liking over time. The beautiful yard with patio offers the opportunity to barbecue and enjoy al fresco dining. It is close to Bernal Heights Park where you can take walks and delight on the beauty the city has to offer. It also offers easy access to tech shuttles, public transit and freeways. Being close to Cortland Ave and North Slope restaurants for dining and shopping enhances the lifestyle aspect of this home.
